name: godotwright
stderr:
Usage: godotwright [options] [command]

AAA coding toolkit for Godot 4.7. Makes any coding agent better at Godot.

Options:
  -v, --version                        print the version
  -h, --help                           show help

Commands:
  scan [options] [path]                map a Godot project: scenes, nodes,
                                       scripts, signals, autoloads and key
                                       settings
  check [options] [path]               run Godot headless and report script and
                                       scene errors with file and line
  shaders [options] [path]             draw every shader with real Godot
                                       (Compatibility renderer, xvfb-run on
                                       Linux without a display) and report
                                       errors at the line in the .gdshader,
                                       .gdshaderinc or .tres/.tscn: the GPU pass
                                       of `godotwright shader --gpu`, without
                                       the review
  test [options] [path]                run the project's GUT or GdUnit4 tests
                                       headless and show only what failed, with
                                       file:line
  play [options] [path]                run a scene headless for a number of
                                       physics frames, play an input timeline
                                       into it, and print the values you watch
                                       per frame: play --input "10 tap jump; 20
                                       hold right 30" --watch Player.position
                                       --watch Player.is_on_floor()
  perf [options] [path]                measure a scene headless: frame-time
                                       percentiles against a budget, the physics
                                       step apart from the rest, the slowest
                                       frames and what changed on them, node and
                                       orphan counts, and the change since the
                                       last run of the same scene
  leaks [options] [path]               find leaks headless: load, run and free a
                                       scene in cycles, snapshot the live
                                       objects after each, and report what grows
                                       per cycle (orphan nodes by class, script
                                       and scene with where they were removed
                                       and made, nodes left in the tree, objects
                                       that are not nodes, what Godot still held
                                       at exit); exit code 1 when growth passes
                                       the budget
  session                              a game session that stays up between
                                       commands: the scene loads once, paused;
                                       `godotwright game` asks it things and
                                       steps it
  game [options]                       ask the running game session (see
                                       `godotwright session start`): tree, get,
                                       set, call, eval, step, signals, layout,
                                       ray, ui, reload, errors
  scenario [options] [path]            run the project's scenarios
                                       (.godotwright/scenarios/*.json): play
                                       input into a scene and check what the
                                       game did; --list them, or --save a new
                                       one after one passing run
  ci [options] [path]                  one receipt for a pull request: review,
                                       Godot check, tests, scenarios and
                                       screenshot baselines, as a markdown table
